text:
Endurance training increases the muscle's capacity for aerobic (oxidative) ATP production, mainly through higher mitochondrial density, more oxidative enzyme activity, and greater capillary supply, so it can sustain submaximal work longer before fatiguing. The team note's claim that endurance training mainly increases shortening velocity is not correct, since maximal shortening velocity depends mostly on myosin heavy-chain isoform and is not the primary endurance adaptation.

CONFIDENCE: 90
